interpretation: Daily mean discharge belongs to USGS 02186702 and supplies regional date context.
Original nutrient station IDs and activity IDs remain distinct; simultaneous calendar date does not establish the same water parcel.
Historical flow and sampling coverage are descriptive of 2020–2025; future saved calendar dates have no received historical observation.
Original below-quantification bounds and paired concentration intervals remain unreplaced.
NLDI navigation indexes whole catchments; same-reach direction uses original ReachCode measures, zero downstream and 100 upstream.
No monitoring objective, cost, campaign binding or selected plan is changed by this context.
